metadata.description: Budget-aware model routing (budget-router) and its markdown-only companion (budget-router-lite) for Claude Code

plugins.name: budget-router
plugins.description: Stop burning your weekly Claude limit by accident. Picks the model and effort for every prompt, turns your weekly limit into a daily budget with a wrap-up warning before the caps tighten, and learns which cheaper setting is enough for your work. Shows the budget in the status bar. Local only: sends nothing, reads no files, adds nothing to your prompts.

plugins.name: budget-router-lite
plugins.description: Make your Claude limit last: one-prompt model and effort switches, a handoff before you clear, a daily-allowance calculator, a verified token-saving cheatsheet and five read-only helper agents. Markdown only.
